posts.title: Two Men, Thirteen Trophies
posts.author: Commissioner
body: Twenty-seven seasons. Twenty-seven trophies. **Erik Marnell has seven of them and Chubby Ryan has six.** That is 48% of every championship this league has ever handed out, won by two of the sixteen-odd people who have played in it.

Their methods could not be less alike. Chubby front-loaded his: **three straight from 2003 to 2005**, then three more in a four-year window from 2013 to 2016. He has not won since. Erik took his time — nothing until 2010, then **2010, 2011, 2012, 2017, 2020, 2022 and 2024**, a title roughly every other year for fifteen years, the most recent one two seasons ago.

Erik also owns three toilet bowls, which is the tell. Dirty South is 195-167-5 lifetime, the most wins in league history, and he still finds a way to bottom out every so often. Chubby has two. Nobody wins seven without occasionally losing badly.

The active chase: **Ron Wasilewski has four** and won as recently as 2021. **John Ryan Jr has three** — 2015, 2023, 2025 — and is the only man to win two of the last three. **Mark Mikita has 191 career wins, second-most all time, and exactly one title**, back in 2007 as the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied with Kyle Ryan for the most anyone has taken. Twenty-five years, one ring, and the strangest résumé on the board.

posts.title: Fourteen and Oh
posts.author: Commissioner
body: There is no asterisk. **Bird Gang went 14-0**, took the first-round bye, won in week 16, and closed it out 108.18 to 79.96 over the ShenHgts Skidmarks. Sixteen games, sixteen wins, one trophy — and the only 100% regular season in twenty-seven years of this league.

The scary part is that it never really looked close. Bird Gang put up **1,585.54 points, the most any team has ever scored in a season**, breaking Dirty South's 1,576 from 2022. They also allowed the fewest points in the league that year, by a margin of 39.

It came within a quarter of a point of being ordinary. **Week 8 against the Jersey Devil Dogz finished 110.32 to 110.08** — a 0.24 margin. Flip one late catch and the whole thing is just a very good 13-1 season nobody writes about.

For the Skidmarks, second place extended one of the odder résumés in the league. Mark Mikita has **191 career wins, second-most of anyone**, and exactly one championship — 2007, back when the team was the Purple Helmets. He also has four toilet bowls, tied for the most. Twenty-five years in, that is a lot of football for one ring.

posts.title: Three of the Five Worst Days in League History
posts.author: Commissioner
body: The *Most Points Allowed — Game* table has five entries. **The Silver Stars are on it three times.**

First came 2021, when they gave up **170** — still the most points any team has surrendered in a single game in twenty-seven years. Then 2025 happened. In **week 16 the Mexican Mafia hung 163.00 on them, and in week 17, 165.14.** Back to back, same opponent, 328.14 points across fourteen days.
Both of those were consolation games. Neither decided anything.

The Mafia went 4-10 that year and are **75-91-3 lifetime**, and yet those two weeks are the highest-scoring games of the Sleeper era — fourth and fifth all time, behind Bird Gang's 170 in 2021 and Big Kahunas' 169 in 2019. It is not the first time the arithmetic has failed Alberto Ruiz. In **2021 the Mafia went 12-2**, matched since only by Dirty South in 2024 and beaten only by Bird Gang's perfect 2025 — and he did not win the title. Twelve seasons in: two toilet bowls, no rings.

The genre is well populated. **Silver Stars led the entire league in scoring in 2023** with 1,491.52 points and lost in the first round, 84.64 to 90.26. **Sponge Bobs scored the second-most points in the league in 2024** and went 7-7. Schedule luck is real and this league is the proof.
